verdict.rationale: The Scribe convert API reference says the language parameter defaults to null, in which case the language is predicted automatically, so developers do not have to declare it. That is a direct, first-party answer to the story, but it rests on a single short parameter description. Missing for 10: documentation of whether the detected language code or confidence is returned in the response, behavior on mixed-language or code-switched audio, whether auto-detection also applies to realtime WebSocket transcription, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the service can detect the spoken language automatically instead of requiring me to declare it

citations.quote: Defaults to null, in this case the language is predicted automatically.
